identity: Redtusk herds and hunts the open savanna; scorpions, rats and a bandit water-broker skim the herds and the wells.

quests.title: Every Stripe Has a Use
quests.text: Gara Stonevoice says your hands are good and your boasts are louder; the zebras can judge both. Bring down eight Waterhole Zebras by day in the {name:grasslands}, {zone_area:grasslands}. Redtusk fills bellies and hide racks from the same hunt; waste any of it and the tanners will tan you instead.

quests.title: Bring the Herders Home
quests.text: A herder watching the herd should not have to watch both boots as well. Kill eight Dust-Stinger Scorpions in the {name:grasslands} after dark. I want our people coming home on their own feet.

quests.title: All Knot, No Rope
quests.text: I tied a pen shut last night and found the knot this morning, with precious little rope attached. Hunt the Dust Gnawers in the {name:tallgrass}, {zone_area:tallgrass}, and kill eight after dark. Give them something worse than rope to bite.

quests.title: Trust the Worn Boots
quests.text: Kesh Longstride has worn enough trail into those boots to know when trouble is moving. Go to Redtusk Outpost and speak to Kesh about what lies beyond the tallgrass. Listen closely; a scout should never have to tell you twice.

quests.title: Give the Bows Their Voices
quests.text: The bowyers have a rack of unstrung bows and a fine collection of excuses. Bring me three Tough Sinew from the Waterhole Zebras that graze the {name:grasslands} by day. Then we can all listen to something besides complaining.

quests.title: Keep It Out of the Stew
quests.text: The hunters want three Bitter Venom for their spears, and I have promised to keep the cooks well away from it. Gather it from Dust-Stinger Scorpions in the {name:grasslands} at night and bring it straight to me. Straight to me, even if somebody offers you a clean bowl.

quests.title: A Gate Worth Shutting
quests.text: Our pen gate groans louder than the beasts behind it, and I know which one will give way first. Bring me six Iron Bars and four Coal Lumps so the smith can mend the hinges. I have spent enough mornings chasing our supper through the dust.

quests.title: Feed the Hands That Tan
quests.text: The dry season is coming, and the tanners cannot work on empty bellies or empty racks. Bring eight pieces of Raw Meat and three Leather; hunt Waterhole Zebras in the {name:tallgrass} by day for the leather. Our hunters will thank us when their boots hold together.

quests.title: Tusks Across the Trail
quests.text: I can read a trail, but these Ridgeback Tuskers keep ploughing tusk marks through it. Kill eight by daylight in the {name:borderveld}, {zone_area:borderveld}. Get them before a caravan finds out how little a loaded cart helps against a charge.

quests.title: Footprints That Never Rest
quests.text: Those Pauper Mummies tramp through the {name:borderveld}, {dir_of:redtusk_outpost:borderveld}, every night without resting. Kill six before they wander onto our supply trails; I would like one watch where every footprint belongs to something breathing.

quests.title: Rokka Is Still Counting
quests.text: The bandits have Rokka Emberhand captive, and Rokka has been counting every stolen barrel that rolls past. Find Rokka in the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, and hear what those thieves would rather keep quiet. Bandits who roll their loot past a prisoner deserve every word that prisoner remembers.

quests.title: Bounty: Teeth in the Dark
quests.text: Dust Gnawers keep chewing their way through our night supplies on the {name:borderveld}. Kill six after dark and report back for your pay. The bounty is available again twenty minutes after you collect; I expect we will still have rats.

quests.title: Eight Fewer Witnesses
quests.text: Keep your voice down. The Bandit Lookouts in the {name:bandit_camp} think I have nothing left to say. Kill eight of them, then come back. I have plenty to say about their master.

quests.title: No Coin for Our Own Water
quests.text: Bandit Water-Broker Korr stands {dir_from_giver:water_broker_korr}, putting a price on water he stole from our wells. Kill him, and bring me two Knotted Talismans from the Bandit Lookouts in the {name:bandit_camp} as proof for the clan. I have listened to him count his profits long enough.

quests.title: Follow the Stolen Water
quests.text: Korr's tallies name buyers in Gor Drazhak; the rot reaches all the way to our capital's tables. Go to the Skull Hall there and tell Thorga Roadspeaker what we found. I counted barrels from captivity; those buyers can start counting their excuses.
